title: InvSave
description: InvSave is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that lets you save, load, and manage custom Creative Mode inventory presets instantly.
body:
InvSave

InvSave is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that lets you save, load, and manage custom Creative Mode inventory presets instantly. Stop rebuilding your inventory every time you switch projects — create reusable loadouts for building, redstone, PvP testing, map making, and more.

Designed to feel simple, fast, and fully integrated into the vanilla Creative inventory.

Features
Save 5 custom inventory presets
Instantly load saved inventories with one click
Rename and organize presets easily
Lightweight and easy-to-use interface
Perfect for builders, redstoners, and creators
Fully client-side
Clean UI integrated into the Creative inventory screen
Use Cases
Builders

Create separate inventories for:

Medieval builds
Modern builds
Landscaping
Decoration blocks
Redstone Engineers

Keep dedicated inventories for:

Redstone components
Command blocks
Technical testing
Debug setups
PvP & Map Testing

Quickly switch between:

PvP kits
Adventure map gear
Potion setups
Mob testing inventories
Why InvSave?

Creative Mode is powerful, but constantly rebuilding inventories slows down workflow and creativity. InvSave solves this by allowing instant inventory switching so you can focus on building instead of searching through tabs.

Compatibility
Fabric
Client-side only
Designed for Creative Mode
